name: NB Footwear Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, NB Footwear Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing of shoes such as hand-crafted shoes, designer shoes, dress shoes, casual shoes, and sandals.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is engaged in the business as tanners, processors, manufacturers, importers, exporters, agents, representatives, dealers and consultants in hides, skins of all animal leather, leather goods and footwear of all kinds.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -33.3%
